value.rationale: The map is the simplest quadratic nonlinear chirp of the critically sampled ordinary cyclic Fourier transform over the first nonfield prime-power ring. It loses exactly (p-1)²/2 independent modes for every odd p, asymptotically half the dimension, and the theorem identifies precisely which character signals are unrecoverable. This is a natural exact infinite-family rank and kernel classification, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice; it motivates nonlinear sampling design and p-adic phase transition questions.
